Under version 2.1, companies must follow the most up‑to‑date SBTi or equivalent criteria for setting the target boundary and emissions coverage, which means achieving 95 % coverage of scopes 1 and 2 emissions and 67 % coverage of scope 3 emissions when scope 3 represents over 40 % of the total inventory; power companies must also meet SBTi sector‑specific criteria, including a third target covering 100 % of downstream fossil‑fuel emissions.

Companies must follow the SBTi criteria for setting the target boundary and emissions coverage, which require 95 % coverage of scopes 1 and 2 emissions and 67 % coverage of scope 3 emissions when scope 3 represents over 40 % of the total inventory; power companies must also meet sector‑specific SBTi criteria, including a third target covering 100 % of emissions from downstream fossil‑fuel use.

The rule on target boundary and emissions coverage was last changed in version 2.1, which added that targets must be submitted at the parent or group level and must include the emissions of all subsidiaries in line with SBTi’s organizational boundary criteria.
Companies may submit targets at either the parent or subsidiary level.
Under version 2.1, companies may submit targets only at the parent or group level, not at the subsidiary level.
